jobs.description:
Alta is looking for a Senior Civil Engineering Project Manager
to join our growing practice in Minneapolis. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who believes in the importance of active, multimodal, and sustainable transportation.

In this role, you will work on the design of a variety of sustainable transportation projects and work on projects focused on making a positive impact on communities around Minnesota and across the country. Engineers who enjoy working closely with other disciplines will appreciate our team’s multi-disciplinary approach that encourages collaboration with our planners, landscape architects, graphics designers, outreach specialists, and data analysts. If you are looking to join an innovative organization and do work that connects people to places while advancing social justice, safety, and environmental resilience, apply with Alta today!

About Alta

Alta is a mission‑driven company working to mitigate climate change and advance safety and social justice by shaping sustainable, people‑centered communities. We bring together expertise across planning, design, engineering, education and encouragement programs, and community engagement to help communities thrive. Our work is grounded in the belief that how places are designed and experienced has a profound impact on equity, health, and opportunity—and that people should always be at the heart of those decisions.

Founded in 1996, Alta was at the forefront of the active transportation movement and has spent nearly 30 years partnering with communities to imagine a more connected, resilient, and inclusive future. Today, with more than 225 staff across the United States and beyond, we are a global leader in creating environments that support everyday life, strengthen human connection, and respond to the challenges of a changing world. Alta offers the opportunity to collaborate across disciplines, contribute to meaningful work at every scale, and be part of a team committed to making lasting, positive change for people and the places they call home.

Day to Day

Our Senior Civil Engineering Project Manager will be involved in helping foster livable communities in all parts of the country. Projects would range from natural surface trails to large arterial multi use paths; from Complete Streets to regional/multi-state bicycle and trail networks.

Day To Day Responsibilities For This Role Would Include

Managing a variety of transportation projects from design through construction. Drive the success of engineering projects and provide influence to the sustainable projects we work on. Manage project budgets.
Implementing best practices and process improvements to enhance project delivery efficiency and effectiveness.
Mentoring staff and contributing to internal professional development and training to technical engineering team.
Provide leadership and technical expertise to the Engineering team. In addition, collaborate with other disciplines (planning, landscape, data) as needed.
Prepare schedule, budgets, and scope of services for projects.
Workload balancing
Support regional leader in business development.
Provide quality control over team deliverables

Qualifications

Required

This position requires a combination of skills, experience and education including, but not limited to

12+ years of experience as a Transportation Engineer in a consulting environment or public entity; 5+ years as a Project Manager; 3+ years managing staff
Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering.
Professional Engineering (P.E.) license or TE (Traffic Engineer) licensure.
Experience in, and knowledge of, the field of active, non-motorized transportation.
Demonstrated understanding of and experience preparing Plans, Specifications and Estimates packages for roadway projects and a detailed understanding of project management principles, methods and techniques.
Ability to guide staff members and manage internal team expectations.
Exhibits strong initiative and ability to capitalize on opportunities to enhance Alta’s position in the marketplace.
Ability to manage competing priorities, multiple simultaneous projects involving cross-functional project teams within budgetary and schedule constraints.
Ability and willingness to travel.
Excellent professional ethics, leadership skills, accountability, and decision-making capabilities.
Good presentation skills.
Working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, MS Project or equivalent, AutoCAD or MicroStation.
Proficiency in an enterprise-wide resource planning and project management tool.

Preferred

There are a number of additional skills, experience, and education that would be beneficial to this position including, but not limited to:

Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, or a related field of study.
Experience managing large projects for both private and public clients.
Experience using Deltek VantagePoint.
Active participation in industry-relevant professional associations and committees.

What We Offer

Flexible Schedule

Alta offers a flexible, hybrid work schedule where most employees work from home three days per week. In-office days support our collaborative culture, one of our core values.

Compensation

is $140,000-$175,000
annually. Placement within the range is based upon experience, skill-sets, and qualifications.

Alta offers comprehensive benefits to all full-time employees:

Medical: PPO or HSA medical plans
Dental/Vision: PPO

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.location: Ramat Gan, Tel Aviv District, Israel
jobs.description:
Alice's RL Gyms team builds adversarial environments and evaluations that the world's leading AI labs use to test and train their most capable agents. Every engagement is a delivery project: a lab specifies what it needs to measure, and we produce the environments, adversarial tasks, and verifiers that measure it, against a deadline and a quality bar the customer sets.

Our customers are the frontier labs. You'll work alongside the people building the models everyone else is reading about, on the problems they haven't solved yet, and what you ship becomes part of how they decide whether an agent is safe to release. Very few roles put you that close to the frontier.

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager to own those projects. You'll run several lab engagements at once, each with its own researchers, engineers, and reviewers. You decide who works on what, you hold the schedule, and you decide whether a batch is good enough to ship.
The field is cutting-edge, and the projects change shape faster than any playbook can describe.

What you'll do

Project ownership

Own concurrent lab engagements end-to-end: scope, milestones, delivery, and status
Turn a customer specification into a task plan with your researchers and engineers: how many tasks, in which environments, against which models, by when
Track every batch through the pipeline (in progress, under review, approved, delivered) and keep the delivery record accurate enough that anyone can read the state of a project in a minute
Surface a slipping deadline early, with the tradeoff already worked out: cut scope, add capacity, or move the date

Researcher allocation and quality

Allocate researchers, task writers, and reviewers across projects based on throughput and specialty
Own their onboarding: brief them on the environment, the attack pattern, and the acceptance criteria, then get them to their first accepted task fast
Give quality feedback on rejected work and spot the patterns behind repeat rejections
Manage the review chain so that no batch reaches the customer before it has cleared internal review

What we're looking for

2 to 4 years in project management, program management, or product management, in a role where you owned a delivery and not just a workstream
High autonomy in an undefined space. The right answer to “what's the process for this?” is usually that you write it
Comfortable managing contributors you don't line-manage: setting expectations, giving direct feedback, and making the call when quality doesn't come up
Fluent written and spoken English

Advantage

A technical background: industrial engineering, computer science, information systems, or equivalent hands-on experience
Exposure to LLMs or AI agents, whether professional or self-taught
Background in security, red teaming, or trust and safety
Experience coordinating a distributed or contract contributor team
Data fluency: SQL, spreadsheets, or scripting well enough to answer your own questions about project throughput

Alice is a trust, safety, and security company built for the AI era. We safeguard the communicative technologies people use to create, collaborate, and interact- whether with each other or with machines.

In a world where AI has fundamentally changed the nature of risk, Alice provides end-to-end coverage across the entire AI lifecycle. We support frontier model labs, enterprises, and UGC platforms with a comprehensive suite of solutions: from model hardening evaluations and pre-deployment red-teaming to runtime guardrails and ongoing drift detection.

Alice is widely considered a global leader in online safety and AI security. We have some of the most forward-thinking and passionate minds in the world working to safeguard over 3 billion users across the largest AI and tech platforms.

If you're creative and driven to secure the future of AI, we want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Justice System Program Manager, Bangladesh
jobs.description:
Who We Are

International Justice Mission (IJM) is a global leader in protecting vulnerable people from violence around the world. Our team of over 1,200 professionals are at work worldwide in over 30 offices. Together we are on a mission to rescue millions, protect half a billion, and make justice unstoppable.

We are a global community that cares for one another. We believe that the way we work is as important as the results we achieve. We provide professional excellence with joy and celebration to all those we serve.

The Need

For over 25 years, IJM has pioneered the work to protect vulnerable people from violence. 9 out of 9 times in the last decade, IJM’s Justice System Strengthening Projects have reduced slavery and violence between 50 and 85% for very large populations of people in poverty. As we grow to expand our impact to protect 500 million people from violence, we are seeking a Justice System Program Manager, who will provide guidance to all the casework team from Bangladesh (Dhaka, Khulna, Mymensingh and Barishal division) and develop strategies to ensure effective and timely prosecution of IJMs cases, strengthen partnerships with the key legal stakeholders to bring the cases through to conviction. The position will report to the Director, Justice System Program.

This role leads the development and implementation of strategic legal interventions to strengthen the response of first responders and justice sector stakeholders in addressing Commercial Sexual Exploitation of Children (CSEC) and advancing IJM’s 2030 goals. The position provides training, technical guidance, and best practices to improve justice system outcomes, while working closely with the Regional Justice Solutions Team, Divisional Directors, casework teams, and partner organizations. The role also supports capacity building, legal strategy implementation, and stakeholder engagement, and requires regular field and court visits with extensive travel across district and divisional levels.

The role is based in Dhaka, but will provide support nationally, including travelling to each of IJM’s future program locations (Khulna, Barisal and Mymensingh).

Responsibilities:

Strategy, Knowledge Development, & Implementation:

Lead and support the design and implementation of legal strategies within justice system transformation projects.
Represent the legal function in project planning, coordination, and strategic initiatives.
Develop legal tools, best practices, and innovative approaches to strengthen case outcomes and victim protection.
Mentor advocates and provide legal compliance guidance to internal teams and partners.
Strengthen the capacity of the criminal justice system to address trafficking and CSEC cases.
Ensure alignment of IJM global legal standards with Bangladesh’s legal framework and legal practices.
Support implementation of IJM’s Protection Model and effective legal interventions.
Provide technical legal expertise, casework support, and strategic guidance to legal teams and partners.
Promote and scale effective legal models, tools, and frameworks across programs.
Support the adoption of global and regional legal standards, resources, and best practices.

Networking & Partnership:

Build and maintain strategic partnerships with legal, judicial, and government stakeholders to strengthen anti-trafficking and CSEC responses.
Develop legal tools, resources, and training materials to support internal teams and external partners.
Represent IJM at legal forums, conferences, and key stakeholder engagements.
Promote the adoption of legal best practices and strengthen partner capacity.
Analyze case and program data to inform reporting and improve justice system outcomes.
Facilitate partnerships and MoUs with academic, judicial, and strategic institutions to advance child protection and anti-trafficking efforts.

Communication:

Development of briefs, papers, fact sheets, and other communication resources as necessary; that articulates IJM’s approach and strategy for Legal casework.
Consistently communicate with IJM legal teams and field leaders about the trends and changes on the legal aspects of human trafficking and protection model across the regions.
Conduct periodical meetings with the National and Divisional legal team to identify the needs, provide feedback on case development, legal strategies, team management, and policy compliances.
Conduct regular meetings with national and specialists to identify the requirements to enhance the capacity of the legal team to achieve IJM’s 2030 vision.
Connect with the National and Divisional Program Directors to give and receive feedback on legal team performance.
Communicate legal Field priorities to the Director, Justice System Program and work towards the alignment on IJM’s 2030 vision strategy.

Policies & Procedures:

Collaborate with the National, South Asia Leadership team and the Divisional Legal team to facilitate the development of comprehensive Legal policies, procedures and best practices.
Provide legal expertise and strategic inputs into various aspects, such as procedures, research, curriculum, contracts, or MOUs, resulting in rigorous and legally sound research, drafting, and decision making.
Collect regional best practices/learnings for Legal casework and support.

Training and Development:

Develop and deliver legal training modules for IJM staff and legal teams on best practices and legal interventions.
Build the capacity of divisional legal staff to support IJM’s 2030 vision.
Facilitate training, coaching, and mentoring on human trafficking and CSEC investigations.
Adapt global legal tools and training materials to the Bangladesh context.
Support capacity building within the criminal justice system and contribute to the development of IJM training resources.
Develop legal tools, resources, and training materials for internal and external stakeholders.
Conduct in-person training sessions for staff, partners, and other stakeholders as required.

Research, Program Management, and M&E:

Engage in research projects as needed to provide legal expertise.
Provide knowledge and advisory services on legal procedures to Partners and CSOs.
Oversee the research on various legal matters as needed and provide recommendations to the policies, manuals, and procedures.
Monitor that Legal activities (internal & with partners) are being implemented well.

Documentation, Reporting & Data Management:

Monitor Legal Data Collection and Analysis.

We’re seeking a dynamic and experienced Project Manager to join Serco’s Naval Acquisition and Sustainment Operation (NASO). This position is contingent upon your ability to maintain your DoD Secret level clearance.

Serco’s Naval Acquisition and Sustainment Operation is part of our high-performing Maritime, Engineering, Technology, and Sustainment Business Unit which provides critical services to nearly all U.S. Navy surface ships, submarines and craft and is achieving truly impactful outcomes. Serco has over 9,000 people in North America, with operations across the U.S. and Canada. In This Role You Will

Lead teams providing technical guidance to Ship's Force relating to work on Hull, Mechanical & Electrical (HM&E) and aviation equipment and systems which interface with combat support systems, and hull support items such as damage control equipment for flooding and fire, climate control/ventilation systems, tank and voids, plenums, etc., habitability improvements, and piping systems. Also encompassed are electrical generation, power and distribution systems including controllers, junction boxes, cabling, and cableways.
Lead the performance of inspections, examinations, analysis, repairs incidental to such and make recommendations in the areas of maintenance planning and/or repair as requested on naval propulsion and auxiliary machinery associated with high pressure steam propulsion plants and U.S. Naval Surface Force Ship propulsion plants and auxiliaries.

Manage teams performing, assisting, or providing technical guidance on the performance of fault identification and support Ship's Force with physical repairs of the types of naval propulsion and auxiliary and aviation/flight deck equipment/combat systems and systems set forth herein

Two years direct experience with auxiliary, electrical, and damage control systems and included steam propulsion plants.
Two years direct experience with auxiliary, electrical and damage control systems for U.S. Naval Ships.
Two years of supervisory experience.
Up to 25% of travel for CONUS/OCONUS may be required.

Knowledge of best practice maritime processes and support methodologies to meet Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) requirements.
Ability to lead and manage large teams.
Ability to operate personal computers and have good knowledge and operational abilities with Microsoft Office tools.
